subject: Erkki Kurenniemi (1941–2017)
note: Every row is a POINTER to something somebody else holds: a title, a date, who holds it, its identifier there, one URL and a licence. Nothing is copied. Statuses and CORS were observed on the date above, not assumed.

precisionConventions.Zenodo: publication_date, always a full day — it dates the DEPOSIT, not always the object.
precisionConventions.National Gallery: yearFrom/yearTo, whole years. Honest: across 2779 dated archive records none sits on 07-15 and only three on 01-01, so a day given here is a real day.
precisionConventions.Wikimedia Commons: a literal QuickStatements qualifier (+1971-01-00T00:00:00Z/10) — Wikidata's integer ladder, 11 day / 10 month / 9 year, declared rather than inferred.
precisionConventions.Wikidata: explicit integer precision. Raw JSON zero-fills, SPARQL start-pads: same fact, two paddings, one declared precision.
precisionConventions.MusicBrainz: release dates only. The eleven tape titles all report 2002, which is the CD, so they are written here with NO date rather than a confident wrong one.
precisionConventions.archive.org: no precision field, and the item's date describes the upload rather than the work — so it is not used as a date at all. Year evidence comes from the filename.
precisionConventions.National Library: a one-letter flag per row, p for day and k for month, and the k rows are start-padded to day 01 — indistinguishable from an attested 1st without the flag.
precisionConventions.ERR (for contrast, not a source here): year-only dates midpoint-padded to YYYY-07-15, indistinguishable from an attested 15 July. Must be reverse-engineered.
